notes.title: We're Joining The Days of Ramadan Festival 2025!
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

Get ready! We're thrilled to announce that we'll be participating in the 2025 Steam Days of Ramadan Festival, running from February 28th at 02:00 GMT+8 to March 31st, 2025, at 02:00 GMT+8!

The 2025 Steam Days of Ramadan Festival marks a first-of-its-kind event, bringing together indie game developers from around the globe for a Ramadan-themed sale. It's a fantastic opportunity for indie devs and game lovers to connect, share ideas, and celebrate Ramadan together.

During the festival, feel free to check out and play the latest games and grab some awesome discounts from across Asia! We hope you have a blast!

notes.title: Our Heartwarming New Title《Reviver》launches on January 9th!
notes.content:
Greetings, everyone!

Mark your calendars! Reviver, our latest creation, launches on Steam January 9th! 
Prepare to be swept away by a narrative puzzle game weaving together romance, time travel, and destiny.ːDaisySHOCKː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2239130

Reviver represents a departure for CottonGame, delving deeper into storytelling and offering richer, more extensive text than our previous titles. 
Experience a poignant love story that spans a lifetime, from youthful exuberance to the golden years.ːDaisyGJː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/db25d6651fd574b60f5501f48c11ee1ebd0f648f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/2f05e8c683fa9dfbddb7cd2729e94e86d27c3ec6.jpg[/img]

True to its name, Reviver embraces the butterfly effect as its core mechanic. 
Your choices, made across different eras, ripple through time, dramatically altering the narrative's course. 
Avert disastrous outcomes with seemingly small decisions, rewriting fate itself!ːtobdogː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/dbd843e213fee95b6db599b520b3780a2b66a57a.png[/img]

ːsteammockingːNaturally, we've retained the signature CottonGame brain-teasing puzzles you've come to expect. 
To complement this, we've sprinkled in a variety of engaging minigames, offering delightful diversions throughout your journey.

Intrigued? Wishlist Reviver now to be notified the moment it releases!ːSpeech_Loveː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840735/c91cbeaecc20dc24d9b40b2b26cde418be6edb24.png[/img]
Stay tuned – more exciting news is on the horizon!

Warmly,ːSpeech_Loveː
CottonGame

notes.title: we at Steam Scream Fest 2024 Edition
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We're excited to announce that "Strange Stories of the Universe" will be part of the Steam Scream Fest from October 28th 10:00 AM (PT) to November 24 10:00 AM (PT)! During this time, you'll be able to enjoy the latest demo version of "Strange Stories of the Universe."

This demo includes the first complete story from the full game, with a playtime of 30 minutes to an hour. While the theme of "Strange Stories of the Universe" remains focused on supernatural events and thrilling content, the style differences between chapters mean this demo may not represent the actual content and experience of other chapters. The full version will feature more diverse styles and gameplay, so stay tuned for further updates and future content additions.

If you enjoy it, please add the game to your wishlist!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191704/09b71bb4aab66f30a8e54e9d1043b666b209d4ec.png[/img]

Your feedback and support are our greatest motivation. Thank you so much for your continued support, and we promise to bring you the best content possible. We look forward to journeying together with you!

Cotton Game

notes.title: Our latest Demo will be featured in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Dear Player,

We're excited to announce that during the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] from October 14th to 20st, you'll be able to enjoy the latest demo of Strange Stories of the Universe to your heart's content!

[h2][b]If you like this, please consider add to your wishlist![/b] [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45191704/09b71bb4aab66f30a8e54e9d1043b666b209d4ec.png[/img]

This demo includes the first complete story of the game, with a playtime of 30 minutes to an hour. Although the theme of Strange Stories of the Universe still focuses on paranormal events and horror content, due to stylistic differences between chapters, this demo does not represent the entirety of the other chapters. The full version will feature more frightful and surprising content. Please look forward to the official release or future content updates.

Your feedback and support are our greatest motivators. Thank you so much for all your support. We're committed to bringing you the best content possible and look forward to moving forward together with you.

Cotton Game
